episodes.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (sq (find-color g 8))
                (r1 (apply min (map first sq)))
                (r2 (apply max (map first sq)))
                (c1 (apply min (map second sq)))
                (c2 (apply max (map second sq)))
                (grayset (find-color g 5))
                (isgray? (lambda (r c) (and (member (list r c) grayset) #t)))
                (inb? (lambda (r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w))))
                (redray (lambda (cr cc dr dc)
                          (let loop
                               ((r (+ cr dr)) (c (+ cc dc)) (acc (list)))
                               (if (not (inb? r c))
                                   acc
                                   (if (isgray? r c)
                                       acc
                                       (if (and
                                             (isgray? r (- c dc))
                                             (isgray? (- r dr) c))
                                           acc
                                           (loop (+ r dr)
                                                 (+ c dc)
                                                 (cons (list r c) acc))))))))
                (corners (list (list r1 c1 -1 -1)
                               (list r1 c2 -1 1)
                               (list r2 c1 1 -1)
                               (list r2 c2 1 1)))
                (redcells (flatmap (lambda (cm)
                                     (redray (first cm)
                                             (second cm)
                                             (third cm)
                                             (fourth cm)))
                                   corners))
                (ycorners (list (list r1 c1 -1 1)
                                (list r1 c2 1 1)
                                (list r2 c2 1 -1)
                                (list r2 c1 -1 -1)))
                (yellowray (lambda (cr cc dr dc)
                             (let* ((sr (+ cr dr))
                                    (sc (+ cc dc)))
                               (if (or (not (inb? sr sc)) (isgray? sr sc))
                                   (list)
                                   (let ((startphase (if (< (* dr dc) 0) 0 1)))
                                     (let loop
                                          ((ar sr) (ac sc)
                                            (phase startphase)
                                            (acc (list (list sr sc))))
                                          (let* ((br (+ ar dr))
                                                 (bc (+ ac dc))
                                                 (pr (if (= phase 0) (+ ar dr) ar))
                                                 (pc (if (= phase 0) ac (+ ac dc))))
                                            (if (not (inb? br bc))
                                                acc
                                                (if (or
                                                      (not (inb? pr pc))
                                                      (isgray? pr pc))
                                                    acc
                                                    (let ((acc2 (cons (list pr pc) acc)))
                                                      (if (isgray? br bc)
                                                          acc2
                                                          (loop br
                                                                bc
                                                                (if (= phase 0) 1 0)
                                                                (cons (list br bc) acc2)))))))))))))
                (yellowcells (flatmap (lambda (cm)
                                        (yellowray (first cm)
                                                   (second cm)
                                                   (third cm)
                                                   (fourth cm)))
                                      ycorners))
                (g1 (recolor-cells g redcells 2)))
           (recolor-cells g1 yellowcells 4))))
